description: Lithium, clozapine, depot antipsychotics and modern antidepressants do not tolerate gaps. A supply interruption produces relapse, hospitalisation and sometimes a permanent step down in baseline function.
energy_note: Two good years undone by a shipping problem.

aspect: Therapy priced in a collapsing currency
description: A session that cost a manageable fraction of a monthly wage in 2017 costs a large one now. Treatment becomes a luxury good in the middle of a mental health emergency.
money_note: Per session, against a collapsed wage.
energy_note: Priced out of your own recovery.

aspect: Research and training are cut off too
description: Sanctions restrict conference attendance, journal access, software and equipment, so the clinical workforce falls behind - a slow degradation of care quality that nobody experiences as an event.
energy_note: A profession quietly falling behind the field.
